name: LedgerHQ
description:
Work with your LedgerHQ books directly in Claude. The connector serves business owners and accounting firms, and follows the same access as your LedgerHQ login.

Ask about any business’s numbers in plain language. Run profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow, trial balance, and financial ratio reports for any date range. Create a PDF when you need something ready to share. Search across every business available to your account, so you can start with a vendor name or amount without knowing where it appears.

Handle daily bookkeeping from the same conversation. Review uncategorized bank transactions, get category suggestions, code transactions, and post them to the books. Create journal entries. Check reconciliation status, review the work queue for one business, or see outstanding work across the companies your accounting firm manages.

The connector can prepare, open, match, finish, and abandon bank reconciliations. Finishing with an accepted difference can post a Reconciliation Entry to the books. 

Deletions, billing, integrations, and client messaging stay in the LedgerHQ app.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LedgerHQ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LedgerHQ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ledgerhq.pro/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LedgerHQ MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LedgerHQ lists 26 MCP tools, including balance_sheet, cancel_reconciliation, cash_flow_statement, categorize_transactions, create_journal_entry, fetch, financial_ratios, finish_reconciliation, get_reconciliation, get_reconciliation_status, get_report_pdf, and get_work_queue.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LedgerHQ?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LedgerHQ in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
LedgerHQ requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LedgerHQ is developed by LedgerHQ. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
